scotland-kingdom.title: Royal Standard of Scotland
desc:
- The Kingdom of Scotland's Royal Standard featured a red rampant lion on gold — one of the oldest heraldic designs in continuous use
- The blue Saltire (St Andrew's Cross) was also used
- **Construction:** a blue field bearing a white saltire (St Andrew's Cross). The saltire extends to all four corners of the flag
trivia:
- The Kingdom of Scotland used its own flag before the union with England
- The lion rampant represents Scottish heraldry
- United with England in 1707 to form Great Britain
